title: sealed spec
description: The standard spec: what a change is meant to do, written by one role before the build and read, unchanged, by every later role. A sealed spec is stored as a content-addressed artifact whose name is the sha256 of its canonical serialization (keys sorted, no insignificant whitespace), bound to the full commit sha it was sealed at. A change to a sealed spec is a new seal whose supersedes names the previous hash, so the chain of seals is visible. The role is an opaque key; this schema names no role. Sections that have no automatic source yet are present and empty, carrying a source of null and a note saying so. schema_version is bumped on any change that an older reader would misread.

role.description: The role that authored and sealed the spec, an opaque key.

head_sha.description: The full commit sha of the branch head the spec was sealed at.

sealed_at.description: UTC time of the seal, to the second.

supersedes.description: The hash of the sealed spec this one replaces, or null for the first seal of a chain.

goal.description: What the change is for, in the author's words.

scope.description: What the change covers and what it deliberately does not.

out.description: Work that is out of scope.

acceptance_criteria.description: The criteria the change is judged against. Each has an id unique within the spec, which a review's coverage pass names.

id.description: Criterion id, unique within the spec.

class_rules.description: The repository class and the rules that class carries, filled from the repo profile when the spec is created.

source.description: profile when read from the repo profile, null when there was none.

note.description: Why the section is empty, when it is.

rules.description: The rule statements of each class in effect, keyed by class.

group_rules.description: Rules that apply to a group of repositories. No source exists yet; the section is authored or left empty.

source.description: Where the items came from; null while there is no source.

note.description: Why the section is empty, when it is.

consumers.description: The consumers of what the change touches and how each is dispositioned. No source exists yet; the section is authored or left empty.

source.description: Where the items came from; null while there is no source.

note.description: Why the section is empty, when it is.

test_plan.description: How the change is tested: the commands the repo profile declares, filled when the spec is created, and the author's plan.

source.description: profile when the declared commands were read from the repo profile.

note.description: Why the declared commands are absent, when they are.

declared.description: The test commands the profile declares, keyed as the profile keys them.

verification_evidence_owed.description: The verdict records that must exist for the change to be accepted, by gate name.

gate.description: The gate name of a verdict record.

rulings_already_made.description: Decisions already made that the build must not reopen.

profile_completeness.description: What the repo profile is still missing or has wrong (missing posture keys, an expired confirmation, a retired file), one line per item, filled when a draft is created.

source.description: Where the items came from; null while there is no source.

note.description: Why the section is empty, when it is.

docs_only_justification.description: Why the change needs no tests because it only changes documentation; null when it does not claim that.
